items.title: 6.3.1.3 Machine Learning and AI in the Cloud

source_refs.note: Topic 6.3.1.3 (PDF 160, printed 157). 'AI' prints as 'Al' in the heading.

blocks.text: The cloud offers powerful tools for building and running machine learning and AI. Google Cloud AI and AWS SageMaker provide platforms to build, train and deploy machine learning models, so data scientists do not need large local computing resources.

blocks.prompt: Why train an AI model in the cloud rather than on a school computer?
blocks.explanation: Training needs a lot of computing power for a short time; the cloud rents it on demand instead of buying expensive hardware.

items: Cloud ML and AI: build, train and deploy models without big local hardware (Google Cloud AI, SageMaker).
